faculty.name: Stephan Anagnostaras
faculty.summary: Studies how the brain produces behavior and cognition through memory consolidation, fear and anxiety, and addiction, using mice.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究大脑如何通过记忆巩固、恐惧与焦虑以及成瘾产生行为与认知，使用小鼠作为模型。

faculty.name: Adam Aron
faculty.summary: Studies social mobilization strategies to address climate change, focusing on emotional responses and belief shifts.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究社会动员策略以应对气候变化，重点关注情感反应和信念转变。

faculty.name: David Barner
faculty.summary: Studies how children and adults understand time, numbers, and space across different cultures, using case studies.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究不同文化中儿童和成人对时间、数字和空间的理解，采用案例研究方法。

faculty.name: Sandra Brown
faculty.summary: Studies adolescent addiction, relapse, and long-term outcomes, using longitudinal studies and neuroimaging.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究青少年成瘾、复发及长期结果，使用纵向研究和神经影像学方法。

faculty.name: Karen Dobkins
faculty.summary: Studies the human condition, focusing on well-being, meditation, learning, and social connection.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究人类状况，关注幸福感、冥想、学习和社交连接。

faculty.name: Gail Heyman
faculty.summary: Studies how children develop social cognition, including reasoning about traits, trust, and reputation management.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究儿童的社会认知发展，包括特质推理、信任和声誉管理。

faculty.name: Eshin Jolly
faculty.summary: Studies how our brains represent and remember other people through social interactions, using naturalistic fMRI and online games.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究大脑如何通过社交互动来表征和记忆他人，使用自然功能性磁共振成像和在线游戏。

faculty.name: Cory Miller
faculty.summary: Studies the cortical basis of behavior, focusing on sensory recognition, categorization, and decision-making in natural species-typical behaviors.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究大脑皮层在行为中的作用，重点关注自然物种典型行为中的感觉识别、分类和决策过程。

faculty.name: Timothy Rickard
faculty.summary: Studies how sleep affects learning and memory, and the cognitive processes involved in recalling information from long-term memory.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究睡眠对学习和记忆的影响，以及从长期记忆中检索信息的认知过程。

faculty.name: Adena Schachner
faculty.summary: Studies how children understand other people and the social meaning of creations like tools and art, and investigates the origins of musicality in early development.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究儿童如何理解他人以及工具和艺术等创造物的社会意义，并探讨音乐性在早期发展中的起源。

faculty.name: John Wixted
faculty.summary: Studies the cognitive mechanisms of recognition memory and its neural representation in the hippocampus, with applications to eyewitness memory reliability.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究识别记忆的认知机制及其在人类海马中的神经表征，并应用于目击记忆的可靠性。

faculty.name: Norman Henry Anderson
faculty.summary: Studies how individuals process information to form judgments and make decisions, developing Information Integration Theory.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究个体如何处理信息形成判断和做出决策，发展了信息整合理论。

faculty.name: Mark Appelbaum
faculty.summary: Studies psychometrics and assessment methods, contributing to educational and policy research.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究心理测量和评估方法，为教育和政策研究做出贡献。

faculty.name: Elizabeth Bates
faculty.summary: Studies cognitive development in children, focusing on language acquisition and social interaction.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究儿童认知发展，重点在于语言习得和社会互动。

faculty.name: J. Anthony Deutsch
faculty.summary: Studies artificial intelligence, attention, learning, memory, and neurobiology of addiction using experimental and theoretical approaches.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究人工智能、注意力、学习与记忆以及成瘾的神经生物学，采用实验和理论方法。

faculty.name: Edmund Fantino
faculty.summary: Studies the principle of delay reduction in behavior, applying behavioral principles to everyday life.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究延迟减少原则在行为中的应用，将行为原则应用于日常生活。

faculty.name: James L. Goodson
faculty.summary: Helps write and publish obituaries, providing step-by-step guides and templates.
faculty.summary_zh: 帮助撰写和发布讣告，提供步骤指南和模板。

faculty.name: Jean Mandler
faculty.summary: Studies how infants develop conceptual thought and challenge traditional views on infant cognition, using innovative techniques.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究婴儿概念思维的发展及其挑战传统婴儿认知的观点，使用创新的技术方法。

faculty.name: Keith Rayner
faculty.summary: Studies cognitive mechanisms of reading in children and adults, using eye-tracking methodology.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究阅读的认知机制，使用眼动追踪方法。

faculty.name: George Reynolds
faculty.summary: Studies cognitive processes and their neural bases, focusing on attention and memory.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究认知过程及其神经基础，重点关注注意力和工作记忆。

faculty.name: David Swinney
faculty.summary: Studies visual perception and attention using neuroimaging techniques.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究视觉感知和注意力，使用神经影像技术。

faculty.name: Psychology Grads
faculty.summary: Studies memory and decision-making processes using behavioral and neuroimaging techniques.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究记忆和决策过程，使用行为和神经影像技术。

faculty.name: Anne Beatty-Martínez
faculty.summary: Studies how language use impacts and supports cognition across the lifespan, using diverse language experiences.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究语言使用如何影响和促进认知发展，利用多样化的语言经验。

faculty.name: Benjamin Bergen
faculty.summary: Studies how people understand and use language, including grammar, word meaning, and metaphor.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究语言的理解和使用，包括语法、词汇意义和比喻。

faculty.name: Lera Boroditsky
faculty.summary: Studies how language shapes thought and meaning creation, exploring cross-linguistic differences in cognitive processes.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究语言如何塑造思维和意义的创造，探索不同语言之间的认知过程差异。

faculty.name: Andrea Chiba
faculty.summary: Studies spatial attention and associative learning, focusing on acetylcholine and amygdala function.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究空间注意力和联想学习，重点关注乙酰胆碱和杏仁体的功能。

faculty.name: Seana Coulson
faculty.summary: Studies cognitive electrophysiology, cognitive semantics, and experimental pragmatics, examining how the brain processes language and meaning.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究认知电生理学、认知语义学和实验语用学，探讨大脑如何处理语言和意义。

faculty.name: Gedeon Deák
faculty.summary: Studies how children learn and develop cognitive flexibility through interaction with caregivers.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究儿童通过与照顾者的互动学习和发展认知灵活性。

faculty.name: Steven Dow
faculty.summary: Studies human-computer interaction and social computing to support creativity.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究人机交互和社会计算以支持创造力。

faculty.name: Deanna Greene
faculty.summary: Studies brain network development in neurodevelopmental disorders like Tourette syndrome, using neuroimaging techniques.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究神经发育障碍（如妥瑞症）中的脑网络发育，使用神经影像技术。

faculty.name: Philip Guo
faculty.summary: Studies human-computer interaction, design, online learning, and computing education to improve programmer productivity.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究人机交互、设计、在线学习和计算教育，以提高程序员的生产力。

faculty.name: Terry L. Jernigan
faculty.summary: Studies the developing human mind and brain, focusing on neurodevelopmental processes and their influences.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究人类大脑和心智的发展，关注神经发育过程及其影响因素。

faculty.name: Meenakshi Khosla
faculty.summary: Develops computational models to explain brain information processing in vision, audition, language, and multimodal perception.
faculty.summary_zh: 开发计算模型来解释大脑在视觉、听觉、语言和多模态感知中的信息处理。

faculty.name: David Kirsh
faculty.summary: Studies design, cognitive ethnography, distributed and embodied cognition, and e-learning, exploring how physical tools and environments shape thinking.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究设计、认知民族志、分布式和嵌入式认知以及在线学习，探讨物理工具和环境如何塑造思考。

faculty.name: Anastasia Kiyonaga
faculty.summary: Studies how the brain creates and sustains temporary mental images to influence actions, exploring the overlap between thought, perception, attention, and movement.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究大脑如何生成和维持短暂的心理表征以指导行为，探索思维、感知、注意和动作之间的交集。

faculty.name: Scott Klemmer
faculty.summary: Studies human-computer interaction and design, developing tools to empower more people to design, program, and learn online.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究人机交互和设计，开发工具以赋能更多人进行设计、编程和在线学习。

faculty.name: Eran Mukamel
faculty.summary: Analyzes large-scale neural data computationally, studying electrophysiology during sleep and anesthesia.
faculty.summary_zh: 分析大规模神经数据，研究睡眠和麻醉期间的电生理学。

faculty.name: Douglas A. Nitz
faculty.summary: Studies the neural basis of spatial cognition and episodic memory, focusing on hippocampus, parietal cortex, and premotor cortex.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究空间认知和情景记忆的神经基础，重点在于海马、顶叶和前运动皮层。

faculty.name: Lara Rangel
faculty.summary: Studies rhythmic coordination of brain activity and dynamic interactions between neurons, exploring learning and memory.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究神经元之间的动态交互作用和脑活动的节律协调，探索学习和记忆机制。

faculty.name: Federico Rossano
faculty.summary: Studies how social cognition develops in humans and other species, focusing on multimodal communication and language evolution.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究人类和其他物种的社会认知发展，重点关注多模态沟通和语言进化。

faculty.name: Ayse P. Saygin
faculty.summary: Studies how the brain processes visual and multisensory information, especially in social contexts, using neuroimaging techniques.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究大脑如何处理视觉和多感官信息，特别是在社会情境中的机制，使用神经成像技术。

faculty.name: Zhuowen Tu
faculty.summary: Studies computer vision, machine learning, and deep learning, integrating neural computation and neuro imaging.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究计算机视觉、机器学习和深度学习，结合神经计算和神经成像。

faculty.name: Bradley Voytek
faculty.summary: Studies how neurons communicate and how the brain and body interact, focusing on aging and disease.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究神经元如何交流以及大脑与身体的相互作用，重点关注衰老和疾病。

faculty.name: Haijun Xia
faculty.summary: Develops tools and techniques for enhancing human creativity using virtual reality and multimodal interaction.
faculty.summary_zh: 开发虚拟现实和多模态交互工具以增强人类创造力。

faculty.name: Martin Zettersten
faculty.summary: Studies how children learn words from active information-seeking, using eye-tracking and looking-time experiments with infants.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究儿童通过主动信息寻求学习词汇的认知发展，使用婴儿的眼动追踪和注视时间实验方法。

faculty.name: Johnatan Aljadeff
faculty.summary: Studies brain organization and function using models of neurons and networks, focusing on representations, learning, and inference.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究神经元和网络模型以理解大脑组织和功能，关注表征、学习和推理。

faculty.name: Nicola Allen
faculty.summary: Studies synaptic plasticity and neurodevelopmental disorders in rodents using electrophysiology and imaging.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究啮齿动物的突触可塑性和神经发育障碍，使用电生理学和成像技术。

faculty.name: Mikio Aoi
faculty.summary: Studies how populations of neurons coordinate their activity to understand behavior dynamics, using new data analysis tools and theoretical frameworks.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究神经元群体活动的协调机制，以理解行为动力学，采用新的数据分析工具和理论框架。

faculty.name: Vineet Augustine
faculty.summary: Studies the peripheral nervous system and cardiac system using opto/chemogenetics, transcriptomics, and machine learning.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究周围神经系统和心脏系统，使用光遗传学、转录组学和机器学习方法。

faculty.name: Eiman Azim
faculty.summary: Studies neural circuits and behavior in rodents using genetic, molecular, and electrophysiological methods.
faculty.summary_zh: 使用遗传、分子和电生理学方法研究啮齿动物的神经回路和行为。

faculty.name: Dhananjay Bambah-Mukku
faculty.summary: Studies the neural basis of decision-making and learning in humans using neuroimaging techniques.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究人类决策和学习的神经基础，使用神经成像技术。

faculty.name: Matthew Banghart
faculty.summary: Studies pain modulation and placebo analgesia using optogenetics, chemogenetics, and electrophysiology.
faculty.summary_zh: 使用光遗传学、化学遗传学和电生理学研究疼痛调节和安慰剂镇痛。

faculty.name: Daniel Bayless
faculty.summary: Studies memory circuits in rodents using optogenetics and imaging, focusing on genetic manipulation and molecular biology.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究使用光遗传学和成像技术的啮齿动物记忆回路，侧重于基因操纵和分子生物学。

faculty.name: Maksim Bazhenov
faculty.summary: Studies how sleep, memory, and learning are regulated by neural networks and oscillations in rodents and humans using computational modeling.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究睡眠、记忆和学习的神经网络和振荡调控机制，使用计算建模方法在啮齿动物和人类中进行.

faculty.name: Marcus Benna
faculty.summary: Studies computational principles of synaptic memory consolidation and efficient coding in the brain using theoretical physics and machine learning.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究神经突触记忆巩固和高效编码的计算原理，使用理论物理和机器学习方法。

faculty.name: MD Divya Bolar
faculty.summary: Studies brain function using fMRI, focusing on blood flow and oxygen metabolism in neuromuscular coupling.
faculty.summary_zh: 使用功能性磁共振成像（fMRI）研究大脑功能，重点关注血液流动和氧代谢在神经肌肉耦合中的作用。

faculty.name: Mark Bondi
faculty.summary: Studies cognitive decline and Alzheimer's disease in older adults, using neuropsychological tests and neuroimaging.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究老年人的认知衰退和阿尔茨海默病，使用神经心理学测试和神经影像学方法。

faculty.name: Timothy Brown
faculty.summary: Studies brain development and cognitive function from infancy to adulthood, focusing on reading, language, and executive functions using imaging techniques.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究从婴儿期到成年期的大脑发育和认知功能，重点在于阅读、语言和执行功能，使用成像技术。

faculty.name: Wendy M. Campana
faculty.summary: Studies pain and neuropathy in rodents, focusing on nerve injury, Schwann cells, and receptors.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究啮齿动物的疼痛和神经病变，重点关注神经损伤、施万细胞和受体。

faculty.name: Michael Castle
faculty.summary: Studies various fields of neuroscience as classified by the National Library of Medicine.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究美国国家医学图书馆分类的各类神经科学领域。

faculty.name: MD Melissa Campbell
faculty.summary: Studies the development of autism using stem cell and mouse models.
faculty.summary_zh: 使用干细胞和小鼠模型研究自闭症的发展机制。

faculty.name: Gert Cauwenberghs
faculty.summary: Studies brain-computer interfaces and neural signal processing for cognitive and neurological disorders.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究脑机接口和神经信号处理，用于认知和神经疾病。

faculty.name: Alex Chaim
faculty.summary: Studies neural mechanisms of learning and memory in development.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究发育过程中学习和记忆的神经机制。

faculty.name: Eric Courchesne
faculty.summary: Studies autism and neural development using functional and structural neuroimaging, focusing on language development and behavior.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究自闭症和神经发育，使用功能性与结构性神经成像，关注语言发展和行为。

faculty.name: Antonio De Maio
faculty.summary: Studies the causes and potential interventions for health and educational disparities among different socioeconomic groups.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究不同社会经济群体之间健康和教育不平等的原因及潜在干预措施。

faculty.name: Virginia de Sa
faculty.summary: Studies how humans integrate sensory information and use computational models to understand brain functions and behavior.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究人类如何整合感官信息以及使用计算模型理解大脑功能和行为。

faculty.name: Kim Dore
faculty.summary: Studies synaptic weakening and resilience in Alzheimer’s disease using model mice and primary neurons, examining molecular mechanisms and potential therapies.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究阿尔茨海默病中突触的削弱和韧性，使用模型小鼠和原代神经元，探讨分子机制和潜在疗法。

faculty.name: Stephanie Dulawa
faculty.summary: Studies rapid-acting antidepressants and perseverative behaviors in animal models using neurophysiology and chemogenetics.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究快速起效抗抑郁药和perseverative行为在动物模型中的作用，使用神经生理学和化学遗传学方法。

faculty.name: Mark Ellisman
faculty.summary: Studies the structure and function of neural circuits using advanced imaging techniques.
faculty.summary_zh: 使用先进的成像技术研究神经回路的结构和功能。

faculty.name: Cole Ferguson
faculty.summary: Studies the neural mechanisms of working memory and attention in adults using neuroimaging techniques.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究成人在工作记忆和注意力方面的神经机制，使用神经影像技术。

faculty.name: Pascal Gagneux
faculty.summary: Studies primate behavior and genetics, focusing on social cognition and communication.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究灵长类动物的行为和遗传学，重点在于社会认知和交流。

faculty.name: MD Douglas Galasko
faculty.summary: Studies the cognitive and neural mechanisms of aging and neurodegenerative diseases, focusing on Alzheimer's disease.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究衰老和神经退行性疾病（如阿尔茨海默病）的认知和神经机制。

faculty.name: Timothy Gentner
faculty.summary: Studies the neural mechanisms of vocal communication in songbirds, focusing on decision processes and auditory perception.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究鸟类（欧洲知更鸟）的鸣叫交流神经机制，重点在于决策过程和听觉感知。

faculty.name: Olivier George
faculty.summary: Studies addiction and its pharmacological treatments using whole-brain imaging and optogenetics.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究成瘾及其药物治疗，使用全脑成像和光遗传学方法。

faculty.name: Vikash Gilja
faculty.summary: Studies neural interfaces and brain-machine interfaces for decoding and modulating motor behavior and speech production.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究神经接口和脑机接口以解码和调节运动行为和言语产生。

faculty.name: Lawrence Goldstein
faculty.summary: Studies the neural basis of working memory and attention using neuroimaging techniques.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究工作记忆和注意力的神经基础，使用神经影像技术。

faculty.name: Hector Gonzalez
faculty.summary: Studies how Hispanic Americans and immigrants manage metabolic syndrome and health expenditures, using cognitive methods.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究西班牙裔美国人和移民如何管理代谢综合征和医疗支出，使用认知方法。

faculty.name: Christina Gremel
faculty.summary: Studies decision-making processes in the brain, focusing on how the brain evaluates risks and rewards.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究大脑中的决策过程，重点关注大脑如何评估风险和奖励。

faculty.name: Eric Halgren
faculty.summary: Studies how ripple oscillations support working memory representations in the brain, using ECoG and nanowire arrays.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究 ripple 振动如何支持工作记忆表征，使用 ECoG 和纳米线阵列技术。

faculty.name: Shelley Halpain
faculty.summary: Studies cytoskeletal mechanisms in neural circuits, using imaging techniques to understand neuronal morphology and plasticity.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究神经回路中的细胞骨架机制，使用成像技术来理解神经元形态和可塑性。

faculty.name: Thomas Hnasko
faculty.summary: Studies neural circuits underlying motivated behaviors and behavioral control using genetic and optogenetic tools.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究动机行为和行为控制的神经回路，使用遗传和光遗传学工具。

faculty.name: Vivian Hook
faculty.summary: Studies cognitive processes and their neural bases, focusing on memory and learning.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究认知过程及其神经基础，重点在于记忆和学习。

faculty.name: Terry Jernigan
faculty.summary: Studies brain development using noninvasive imaging techniques, focusing on drug abuse and addiction.
faculty.summary_zh: 使用非侵入性成像技术研究大脑发育，重点关注药物滥用和成瘾机制。

faculty.name: William Joiner
faculty.summary: Studies how fruitflies and rodents sleep, learn, and remember, using ion channels, synaptic transmission, and circuit mapping.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究果蝇和啮齿动物的睡眠、学习和记忆，使用离子通道、突触传递和电路映射的方法。

faculty.name: Sasha Kauffman
faculty.summary: Studies how brain and hormones interact to control reproduction in mammals, using rodent models.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究大脑和激素如何控制哺乳动物的生殖，使用啮齿动物模型。

faculty.name: Ann Kennedy
faculty.summary: Studies brain circuitry and neural coding in animals to understand behavior, emotion, and learning.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究动物的大脑电路和神经编码，以理解行为、情绪和学习。

faculty.name: David Kleinfeld
faculty.summary: Studies brainstem circuits and feedback mechanisms using optogenetics, imaging, and electrophysiology in rodents.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究使用光遗传学、成像和电生理学方法在啮齿动物中的脑干回路和反馈机制。

faculty.name: Rob Knight
faculty.summary: Studies the evolution of microbial ecosystems using computational and experimental techniques, focusing on human body microbiomes.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究微生物生态系统的进化，使用计算和实验技术，重点关注人体微生物组。

faculty.name: Takaki Komiya
faculty.summary: Studies how rodents learn and make decisions using in-vivo two-photon imaging and optogenetics.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究啮齿动物的学习和决策机制，使用在体双光子成像和光遗传学技术。

faculty.name: Jill Leutgeb
faculty.summary: Studies brain systems for behavior, focusing on organizational transformation and leadership in health sciences.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究大脑系统的行为机制，关注健康科学中的组织转型和领导力。

faculty.name: Stefan Leutgeb
faculty.summary: Studies neural mechanisms of memory and spatial navigation in rodents using neurophysiology and imaging techniques.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究啮齿动物记忆和空间导航的神经机制，使用神经生理学和成像技术。

faculty.name: Byungkook Lim
faculty.summary: Studies how rodents learn and behave in response to stress and addiction, using molecular, cellular, genetic, and circuit approaches.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究啮齿动物在应激和成瘾反应中的学习和行为，使用分子、细胞、遗传和电路方法。

faculty.name: Giordano Lippi
faculty.summary: Studies gene expression and neural networks in neurodevelopmental disorders like autism and schizophrenia.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究神经发育障碍（如自闭症和精神分裂症）中的基因表达和神经网络。

faculty.name: Loren Looger
faculty.summary: Develops fluorescent proteins and imaging tools for neuroscience research.
faculty.summary_zh: 开发荧光蛋白和成像工具，用于神经科学研究。

faculty.name: Matthew Lovett-Barron
faculty.summary: Studies how internal states influence neural circuits and behavior using optogenetics, 2-photon imaging, and virtual reality.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究内部状态如何影响神经回路和行为，使用光遗传学、双光子成像和虚拟现实技术。

faculty.name: Carolina Makowski
faculty.summary: Studies neuropsychiatric disorders using human neuroimaging and genomics.
faculty.summary_zh: 使用人类神经成像和基因组学研究神经精神疾病。

faculty.name: MD Michael McCarthy
faculty.summary: Studies cognitive processes and neural mechanisms involved in attention and memory, using neuroimaging techniques.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究注意和记忆的认知过程及其神经机制，使用神经影像技术。

faculty.name: Andrew Mendiola
faculty.summary: Studies how children learn words from social cues, using eye-tracking and looking-time experiments with infants.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究儿童如何通过社会线索学习单词，使用婴儿的眼动追踪和注视时间实验。

faculty.name: Gal Mishne
faculty.summary: Studies geometric representation learning and diffusion geometry to decode neural activity for handwriting BCIs and generalizable speech neuroprostheses.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究几何表示学习和扩散几何学以解码神经活动，用于手写BCI和可泛化的语音神经假体。

faculty.name: Jyoti Mishra
faculty.summary: Studies how circuits in the brain influence behavior and cognition, using electrophysiology and neuroimaging to understand attention, learning, and plasticity in development and ADHD.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究大脑电路如何影响行为和认知，使用电生理学和神经成像技术理解注意力、学习和发育及ADHD中的可塑性。

faculty.name: MD William Mobley
faculty.summary: Studies cognitive and neural mechanisms in Down syndrome, using behavioral and neuroimaging techniques.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究唐氏综合症的认知和神经机制，使用行为和神经影像技术。

faculty.name: Alysson Muotri
faculty.summary: Studies brain systems for behavior using animal models.
faculty.summary_zh: 使用动物模型研究大脑系统对行为的作用。

faculty.name: Douglas Nitz
faculty.summary: Studies how rodents navigate using single neuron recordings and chemogenetics, focusing on spatial cognition, decision-making, and attention.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究啮齿动物的空间认知、决策和注意力，使用单神经元记录和化学遗传学方法。

faculty.name: Nick Oesch
faculty.summary: Studies how neurons in the retina process information for perception and behavior, developing treatments for blindness.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究视网膜神经元如何处理信息以产生感知和行为，并开发治疗失明的方法。

faculty.name: Abraham Palmer
faculty.summary: Studies genetic and cellular bases of addiction, anxiety, and depression in rodents.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究啮齿动物成瘾、焦虑和抑郁的遗传和细胞基础。

faculty.name: Talmo Pereira
faculty.summary: Develops computational tools and AI models to study neural circuits in animals using deep learning and computer vision.
faculty.summary_zh: 开发计算工具和AI模型，使用深度学习和计算机视觉研究动物的神经回路。

faculty.name: Chen Ran
faculty.summary: Studies neural circuits and coding related to visceral organs and autonomic physiology using imaging techniques.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究与内脏器官和自主生理相关的神经电路和编码，使用成像技术。

faculty.name: Victoria Risbrough
faculty.summary: Studies the genetic and behavioral aspects of anxiety and PTSD in rodents and humans, using pharmacology and fear learning experiments.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究焦虑和PTSD的遗传和行为方面，使用啮齿动物和人类的药理学和恐惧学习实验。

faculty.name: MD Subhojit Roy
faculty.summary: Studies neurodegeneration, focusing on Parkinson’s disease and Alzheimer’s Disease, particularly the role of -synuclein in axons, dendrites, and synapses.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究神经退行性疾病，特别是帕金森病和阿尔茨海默病，关注α-突触核蛋白在轴突、树突和突触中的作用。

faculty.name: Allen Ryan
faculty.summary: Studies the neural basis of working memory and attention in humans using neuroimaging techniques.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究人类工作记忆和注意力的神经基础，使用神经影像技术。

faculty.name: David Salmon
faculty.summary: Studies early detection of dementia and Alzheimer's using neuropsychological testing and psychometric methods.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究使用神经心理学测试和心理测量方法早期检测痴呆和阿尔茨海默病。

faculty.name: Ayse Saygin
faculty.summary: Studies how humans perceive and understand social cues, using artificial agents and natural stimuli to explore representational plasticity and attention.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究人类如何感知和社会认知，使用人工代理和自然刺激探索表征可塑性和注意力。

faculty.name: Johannes Schöneberg
faculty.summary: Develops 4D adaptive optics lattice light-sheet imaging techniques to study mitochondrial dynamics in organoids.
faculty.summary_zh: 开发4D自适应光学晶格光片成像技术，研究类器官中线粒体动力学。

faculty.name: Terrence Sejnowski
faculty.summary: Studies neural circuits and synaptic physiology, using computational modeling and electrophysiology to explore learning, memory, and schizophrenia.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究神经回路和突触生理学，使用计算建模和电生理学探索学习、记忆和精神分裂症。

faculty.name: Katerina Semendeferi
faculty.summary: Studies the neural systems involved in complex cognitive and emotional processes in humans, apes, and other primates, as well as in human mental disorders.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究人类、猿类和其他灵长类动物中复杂认知和情绪过程的神经系统，以及人类精神障碍。

faculty.name: John Serences
faculty.summary: Studies how behavioral goals influence perception, decision making, and memory using psychophysics, computational modeling, and neuroimaging in humans.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究行为目标如何影响知觉、决策和记忆，使用心理物理学、计算建模和神经影像学方法在人类被试中进行研究。

faculty.name: DVM Christina Sigurdson
faculty.summary: Studies prion neurotoxicity and prion aggregate spread in the brain, using various lab members and postdocs.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究朊病毒神经毒性及朊病毒包涵体在大脑中的传播，使用多名实验室成员和博士后。

faculty.name: Christine Smith
faculty.summary: Studies brain injury and Alzheimer's using neuroimaging and eye-tracking to understand learning and memory.
faculty.summary_zh: 使用神经成像和眼动追踪研究脑损伤和阿尔茨海默病的认知和记忆机制。

faculty.name: Monique Smith
faculty.summary: Studies pain, emotion, empathy, and addiction in mice, focusing on social behaviors.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究疼痛、情绪、同理心和成瘾行为在小鼠中的机制。

faculty.name: Nicholas Spitzer
faculty.summary: Studies how neurons change their neurotransmitters in response to environmental stimuli, affecting behavior and memory in both developing and adult brains.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究神经元在环境刺激下改变神经递质的身份，影响发育和成年大脑的行为和记忆。

faculty.name: Scott Sternson
faculty.summary: Studies circuits and molecular mechanisms of appetite and addiction using chemogenetics, optogenetics, and bioinformatics.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究食欲和成瘾的神经环路和分子机制，使用化学遗传学、光遗传学和生物信息学方法。

faculty.name: MD Neal Swerdlow
faculty.summary: Studies brain systems for behavior, focusing on organizational transformation and leadership in health sciences.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究大脑系统的行为机制，专注于健康科学中的组织转型和领导力。

faculty.name: Michael Taffe
faculty.summary: Studies drug addiction and psychoactive drugs using neuropharmacology and immune system interactions.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究药物成瘾和精神活性药物，使用神经药理学和免疫系统交互机制。

faculty.name: Palmer Taylor
faculty.summary: Studies pharmacology and drug development, focusing on pharmaceutical sciences and disease mechanisms.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究药物开发和药理学，专注于药物科学和疾病机制。

faculty.name: Francesca Telese
faculty.summary: Studies the genetic and epigenetic mechanisms underlying behavior using single cell genomics.
faculty.summary_zh: 使用单细胞基因组学研究行为的遗传和表观遗传机制。

faculty.name: Justin Trotter
faculty.summary: Studies the molecular interactions between astrocytes and neurons in tripartite synapses, and how these interactions affect prosocial behaviors and psychiatric disorders.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究星形胶质细胞与神经元在三突触中的分子交互作用及其对亲社会行为和精神疾病的影响。

faculty.name: Miles Wilkinson
faculty.summary: Studies the neural basis of working memory and attention in humans using neuroimaging techniques.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究人类工作记忆和注意力的神经基础，使用神经成像技术。

faculty.name: Li Ye
faculty.summary: Studies the genetic and molecular basis of behavior using whole-brain imaging, optogenetics, and unbiased screening.
faculty.summary_zh: 使用全脑成像、光遗传学和无偏筛选研究行为的遗传和分子基础。

faculty.name: Binhai Zheng
faculty.summary: Studies neural repair and regeneration, developing therapies for spinal cord injury, stroke, and neurodegenerative diseases.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究神经修复和再生，开发治疗脊髓损伤、中风和神经退行性疾病的疗法。

faculty.name: Sheng Zhong
faculty.summary: Studies genetic and genomic factors influencing behavior and regeneration using single-cell chromatin and imaging techniques.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究单细胞染色质和基因组因素对行为和再生的影响，使用成像技术。

faculty.name: Yimin Zou
faculty.summary: Studies cognitive and neural mechanisms of memory and learning, using various NIH-funded projects.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究记忆和学习的认知和神经机制，使用多项NIH资助的项目。
